<json>
{
  "states": [
    "NoSession",
    "SessionEstablished",
    "MediaPlaying",
    "MediaPaused",
    "SessionTerminated"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "NoSession",
      "event": "receive SETUP",
      "action": "create session context",
      "to": "SessionEstablished"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionEstablished",
      "event": "receive PLAY",
      "action": "start media delivery",
      "to": "MediaPlaying"
    },
    {
      "from": "MediaPlaying",
      "event": "receive PAUSE",
      "action": "halt media delivery",
      "to": "MediaPaused"
    },
    {
      "from": "MediaPaused",
      "event": "receive PLAY",
      "action": "resume media delivery",
      "to": "MediaPlaying"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionEstablished",
      "event": "receive TEARDOWN",
      "action": "terminate session context",
      "to": "SessionTerminated"
    },
    {
      "from": "MediaPlaying",
      "event": "receive TEARDOWN",
      "action": "terminate session context",
      "to": "SessionTerminated"
    },
    {
      "from": "MediaPaused",
      "event": "receive TEARDOWN",
      "action": "terminate session context",
      "to": "SessionTerminated"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionEstablished",
      "event": "timeout liveness",
      "action": "terminate session context",
      "to": "SessionTerminated"
    },
    {
      "from": "MediaPlaying",
      "event": "timeout liveness",
      "action": "terminate session context",
      "to": "SessionTerminated"
    },
    {
      "from": "MediaPaused",
      "event": "timeout liveness",
      "action": "terminate session context",
      "to": "SessionTerminated"
    }
  ]
}
</json>

<json>
{
  "states": [
    "Idle",
    "CheckingCredentials",
    "AwaitingApproval",
    "Forwarding"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Idle",
      "event": "receive SETUP User method",
      "action": "extract certificate chain",
      "to": "CheckingCredentials"
    },
    {
      "from": "CheckingCredentials",
      "event": "cond hash_present",
      "action": "forward request",
      "to": "Forwarding"
    },
    {
      "from": "CheckingCredentials",
      "event": "cond hash_missing",
      "action": "reply 470 or 407",
      "to": "AwaitingApproval"
    },
    {
      "from": "AwaitingApproval",
      "event": "receive SETUP with hash",
      "action": "verify and forward",
      "to": "Forwarding"
    }
  ]
}
</json>

<json>
{
  "states": [
    "Init",
    "Ready",
    "Play"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Init",
      "event": "receive SETUP",
      "action": "set NRM=1, RP=0.0",
      "to": "Ready"
    },
    {
      "from": "Init",
      "event": "receive SETUP (Redirect)",
      "action": "reply 3rr Redirect",
      "to": "Init"
    },
    {
      "from": "Init",
      "event": "cond S->C REDIRECT",
      "action": "terminate session",
      "to": "Init"
    },
    {
      "from": "Ready",
      "event": "receive SETUP (New URI)",
      "action": "set NRM+=1",
      "to": "Ready"
    },
    {
      "from": "Ready",
      "event": "receive SETUP (Prior URI)",
      "action": "change transport param",
      "to": "Ready"
    },
    {
      "from": "Ready",
      "event": "receive TEARDOWN (Prs URI)",
      "action": "reply No session hdr, NRM=0",
      "to": "Init"
    },
    {
      "from": "Ready",
      "event": "receive TEARDOWN (md URI, NRM=1)",
      "action": "reply No Session hdr, NRM=0",
      "to": "Init"
    },
    {
      "from": "Ready",
      "event": "receive TEARDOWN (md URI, NRM>1)",
      "action": "reply Session hdr, NRM-=1",
      "to": "Ready"
    },
    {
      "from": "Ready",
      "event": "receive PLAY",
      "action": "play from RP/range",
      "to": "Play"
    },
    {
      "from": "Ready",
      "event": "receive PAUSE (Prs URI)",
      "action": "return PP",
      "to": "Ready"
    },
    {
      "from": "Ready",
      "event": "cond SC:REDIRECT (Terminate-Reason)",
      "action": "set RedP",
      "to": "Ready"
    },
    {
      "from": "Ready",
      "event": "cond SC:REDIRECT (No Time)",
      "action": "remove session",
      "to": "Init"
    },
    {
      "from": "Ready",
      "event": "timeout",
      "action": "terminate session",
      "to": "Init"
    },
    {
      "from": "Ready",
      "event": "cond RedP reached",
      "action": "TEARDOWN of session",
      "to": "Init"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "receive PAUSE (Prs URI)",
      "action": "set RP to present point",
      "to": "Ready"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "cond End of media",
      "action": "set RP = End of media",
      "to": "Play"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "cond End of range",
      "action": "set RP = End of range",
      "to": "Play"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "receive PLAY",
      "action": "play from present point/range",
      "to": "Play"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "cond SC:PLAY_NOTIFY",
      "action": "reply 200",
      "to": "Play"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "receive SETUP (New URI)",
      "action": "reply 455",
      "to": "Play"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "receive SETUP (md URI)",
      "action": "reply 455",
      "to": "Play"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "receive SETUP (md URI, IFI)",
      "action": "change transport param",
      "to": "Play"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "receive TEARDOWN (Prs URI)",
      "action": "reply No session hdr",
      "to": "Init"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "receive TEARDOWN (md URI, NRM=1)",
      "action": "reply No Session hdr, NRM=0",
      "to": "Init"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "receive TEARDOWN (md URI)",
      "action": "reply 455",
      "to": "Play"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "cond SC:REDIRECT (Terminate Reason)",
      "action": "set RedP",
      "to": "Play"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "cond SC:REDIRECT",
      "action": "remove session",
      "to": "Init"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "cond RedP reached",
      "action": "TEARDOWN of session",
      "to": "Init"
    },
    {
      "from": "Play",
      "event": "timeout",
      "action": "Stop Media playout",
      "to": "Init"
    }
  ]
}
</json>
